paths.name: @userhq/db
paths.message: apps/web must not import DB code directly to keep DB credentials out of the web image

paths.name: drizzle-orm
paths.message: apps/web must not import drizzle-orm; DB access is reserved for apps/api

paths.name: pg
paths.message: apps/web must not import pg driver; DB access is reserved for apps/api

paths.name: sharp
paths.message: sharp is restricted to apps/api; native modules fail in RSC dev

paths.name: next-auth
paths.message: next-auth is unsupported in vinext; use better-auth

paths.name: radix-ui
paths.message: radix-ui barrel hangs the build under isolated installs; use individual @radix-ui/react-* packages

paths.name: next/image
paths.message: next/image is served unresized on Node; use plain img with API-generated WebP widths

paths.name: next/font/google
paths.message: next/font/google loads from runtime CDN; use @fontsource-variable/*

paths.name: vinext
paths.message: vinext should not be imported in web app code to keep next build escape hatch open

patterns.message: apps/web must not import drizzle-orm subpaths
vinext/* imports are forbidden in web app code
Vite query suffixes (*?raw, *?url, *?inline) break the next build escape hatch
apps/web may only import client entries (better-auth/react, better-auth/cookies, better-auth/client)
